title: Thermal Conductivity Under Asymmetric Momentum Noise
exact_target: Determine whether the specified asymmetric momentum noise makes the harmonic chain's thermal conductivity finite.

status_qualification: This noise does not conserve total momentum, as the report explicitly says. The catalogue literature assessment quotes results for a different energy-and-momentum-conserving noise. Those results do not answer this asymmetric-noise question; pinning, dimension, equilibrium, and limit conventions must remain those of the source model.
